segments.oily: Reviewers with oily skin report the pads calm and hydrate without irritation, are especially comforting on extra-oily days such as summer, and one recommends them specifically for oily skin because they balance oil without feeling harsh.
segments.dry: Reports from dry skin are mixed: some say the pads calm redness and blemishes without over-drying the skin, while one with dry skin reports the blemishes she hoped to clear did not subside and her cheeks became tingly and red.
segments.combination: Many reviewers describe their skin as combination and dehydrated; most report the pads calm heat, redness, and incoming blemishes without feeling oily, though several note the hydration from the pads alone doesn't last and needs a moisturizer layered on top, and one saw no improvement on blemishes she already had.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive and 'super sensitive' skin is the most discussed segment, with most reviewers reporting the pads calm redness and blemishes with no tingling or irritation even after extended wear, while several others warn the gauze texture or tea tree can still irritate very reactive skin, so patch-testing or using it briefly as a mask rather than wiping is recommended for that group.

concerns.dehydration: Opinions split sharply: many reviewers describe the pads as very hydrating, leaving skin plump and moisturized, while a similar number say the hydration is light or doesn't last, recommending a moisturizer applied right after, especially for dehydrated combination or dry skin.
concerns.redness: Most reviewers, including several with sensitive or redness-prone skin, report the pads noticeably calm heat, flushing, and redness, sometimes within one use, and this is repeatedly named as the product's strongest effect. A few dissent: one warns it can trigger significant reactions in very sensitive skin, and one with dry skin developed new tingling and redness from using it.
concerns.barrier: The one reviewer who used the pads while her skin barrier was compromised found they caused a tingling sensation and did not meaningfully help with blemish reduction in that state.
concerns.spots: A few reviewers tracking acne scars and marks report they faded slightly with consistent use, alongside the active blemishes calming down, but none describe the scars disappearing completely.
concerns.blemishes: Most reviewers report a noticeable reduction in blemishes and breakouts with regular use, some within a single night, and several with acne-prone skin call it their most effective product for calming flare-ups. A consistent minority dissent, saying it only prevents new blemishes without clearing existing ones or had no visible effect at all, and one felt daily use over-treated her skin and worked better used sparingly.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers with oily skin, and others who dislike products that feel greasy, report the pads control oil and leave a non-oily finish without feeling harsh.

extraits.texte: I have dry skin. Recently, I've been experiencing more blemishes, so I decided to try this product since it's well­known and often advertised. After using about 1.5 bottles, I feel it has some soothing effects, and it absorbs well into the skin. I had high hopes when I heard that blemishes would almost disappear within a month of use. However, it didn't live up to my expectations as the blemishes didn't subside easily, which was a bit disappointing. The effects weren't impressive enough for me to recommend it. I'm not sure if it prevented more blemishes from appearing or if it actually caused more. My cheeks felt a bit tingly and developed some redness, so I wouldn't recommend this for those with super sensitive skin.

extraits.titre: First off, my skin type is...
extraits.texte: First off, my skin type is combination dehydrated with severe acne­prone blemishes. I'm currently on my 5th bottle, and I find it quite satisfactory without any major drawbacks! It definitely helps reduce skin heat and gives a noticeable soothing effect! It made me realize there's a good reason why some products become so popular. However, when I used it while my skin was super sensitive and my skin barrier was compromised, it felt a bit tingling. It didn't significantly help with blemish reduction. I'd recommend it if you're looking for a decent pad that's easy to use. The pads are made of gauze, so if used as an exfoliating toner, it might feel a bit harsh. For those with sensitive skin, I'd suggest using it as a mask rather than an exfoliating toner.
Before using this product, I had given up on solving my inflammation and acne. Now both are biting the dust and I hardly wear makeup. I finally feel like a confident 30 year-old!

good for acne and sensitive skin! dry skin girlies are safe from excessive drying. Doesn't remove acne but helps calm it down. wearing it as a mask makes my face feel clean but pads are too small for full sheet mask, best to put it only on problem areas only to save pads.

Before using these tea tree toner pads, I used collagen pads, but I think the tea tree pads suit me better. I have oily skin, so maybe that's why these pads work so well for me. They really calm my skin, provide great hydration, and even refine my skin texture! Honestly, every time I use them, I'm amazed at how soft and smooth my skin feels. They're especially comforting when used in summer or on days when my skin is extra oily. I can use them daily without any irritation, which is great, and they're perfect to use before applying makeup! I'll definitely be repurchasing these. Perhaps the only slightly disappointing aspect is the packaging. Sometimes it's hard to tell if the lid is properly closed, as there's no distinct click or feeling when you close it. However, the pads themselves were absolutely fine, and I was really satisfied with how they performed! Usually, I start by taking out three pads. I gently wipe my skin with each one, then leave them on my face like a mask. After a few minutes, I use the same pads to thoroughly cleanse my skin, paying extra attention to areas like my nose or any blemishes. Afterwards, I always apply a soothing serum and cream! And if you're using these in the morning, don't forget to apply sunscreen ­ it's absolutely essential!

extraits.titre: I've been using this for about...
extraits.texte: I've been using this for about 3 days now, and I'm already on my third bottle! While I haven't seen miraculous results, I've noticed my blemishes and acne scars have calmed down a bit and slightly faded. I have combination dehydrated skin with some acne and quite a few scars. The cooling sensation when applying helps reduce redness, which is great! However, the hydration doesn't last very long, which is a bit disappointing. Despite that, I'm enjoying using this product overall! The hydration doesn't last very long, unfortunately. Also, it definitely doesn't completely eliminate blemishes or scars.

Skin type: Extremely dry, sensitive, blemish­prone skin I've used two types of Mediheal pads ­ Watermide and Phytoenzyme ­ and loved them both! Now that the weather is getting warmer, I thought tea tree might be better for soothing, so I tried it for the first time. It's great for calming the skin, and I recommend applying it to your cheeks before makeup. The pads are a bit thin, so I wouldn't recommend them as an exfoliating toner. However, they work well as a quick mask!
